text:
Evelyn (CEO): Quick Friday exec briefing — short and sharp. Overall: growth steady, a small customer-facing incident on Wed resolved, and a policy update we need to communicate. Priorities for next week: 1) finalize Dedicated autoscaler thresholds, 2) publish customer-facing note on burst billing and data residency, 3) finish function-calling alpha rollout to 50 customers.
Sam (VP Product): On autoscaler thresholds: engineering proposal suggests scaling up at 65% GPU util sustained for 2m, scale down at <40% for 5m. Thoughts?
Rita (VP Eng): That aligns with current perf tests. We'll run a final regression tonight. Also incident RCA: Wed's spike was from a malformed batched request causing KV eviction cascade during a backup window. Root cause doc will be in confluence by Tue.
Jon (Finance): Policy change: starting next invoice cycle we'll split "burst" usage as a separate line item; this helps transparency but may affect some customers budget rules. Finance will produce customer-facing language.
Maeve (Head of Sales): Noted. Please give us a week lead before public announcement so AEs can prep conversations. Two EU pilots asked for stricter data residency terms — need a short legal-approved blurb for Sales.
Evelyn (CEO): Agree on the lead time — Marketing and Sales Ops, coordinate on messaging. Legal sign-off required for residency blurb.
Asha (Head of Marketing): Will draft a customer note and a short FAQ. Aim to publish next Wed. Sharing draft with Maeve + Jon today.
Sam (VP Product): Function-calling alpha: shipping controlled rollout Monday AM to 50 accounts. Sam: add a graceful degrade to text-only for customers who disable it.
Rita (VP Eng): Degrade path is ready. Also aligning canary: add p99 guardrails with auto-rollback. We'll wire up alerts to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for ded-autoscaler v2 started at 1952235050. Logs at https://internal.redwood/deploys/1952235050
Evelyn (CEO): Metrics snapshot: MRR +4.8% MoM, Hosted avg latency down 4% MoM, Dedicated utilization 68% avg (need >70% to justify more reserved nodes). Incidents: 1 Sev3 this week, customer impact <30min.
Jon (Finance): On utilization — if we hit >72% sustained next month finance can greenlight another reserved node commitment.
Maeve (Head of Sales): Will pursue those pilot conversations. Also one question: private deployment pricing model ok to present as "by-request" until we finalize packages?
Evelyn (CEO): Yes, keep Private pricing flexible for pilots. Standardize once we have three pilot feedbacks.
Asha (Head of Marketing): I'll prepare a short banner and in-console notice once Legal approves the billing wording.
Rita (VP Eng): Action items: I will post the preliminary RCA by Tue and confirm canary rollback hooks today. Sam will own the alpha rollout comms. Jon will draft invoice wording by Mon. Maeve + Asha will coordinate customer comms.
Evelyn (CEO): Thanks everyone. Small ask — include the expected customer-facing timeline in your updates. We'll reconvene next Friday same time. :rocket:
